info.title: Robotics Expert Course Platform API
info.summary: Curriculum content, learner progress and reports over HTTP.

get.description: Liveness: the process answers.
Readiness: the curriculum is indexed and the progress store opens.
The installed package version.

Prometheus text format: request counts, latency, in-flight requests, DB pools.

Open by default and meant for the internal network: block ``/metrics`` at the reverse
proxy, or set ``RC_API_METRICS_TOKEN`` to require ``Authorization: Bearer <token>``
(SRV-16). ``RC_API_METRICS=0`` turns the endpoint off (404).
Every course in the curriculum, with its text in the requested language.

schema.title: Response List Courses Api V1 Courses Get

get.description: One course with its modules grouped by level (consecutive modules of one level).
One module with its lessons in teaching order.

Lesson metadata, Markdown body, resources, and the study-method section.

``Accept-Language`` picks a translation (``<lesson>.<lang>.md``); a lesson without one
answers in the language it was written in, which ``lang`` in the response states.
Resources of every lesson in teaching order, merged by (title, url).

schema.title: Response List Resources Api V1 Resources Get

get.description:
Search lessons (title, summary, objectives, tags) and their resources (title, note).

Every word must match; title matches rank first, then tags, then other text.

schema.title: Response Search Content Api V1 Search Get

get.description:
Level -> module -> lesson tree with the caller's states (``rc roadmap``).

Lesson state: done, in_progress, locked (a prerequisite is not done) or available. Module
state: done if every lesson is done, in_progress if any is started or done, locked if every
lesson is locked, else available. Progress values are fractions (0-1).

Every lesson's progress in teaching order, the running timer, and the dashboard numbers.

The dashboard part (``stages``, ``week``, ``streak_days``, ``due_cards``) is the same
aggregate the static site and ``rc status`` show, and covers every course even when
``course`` narrows the lesson list.
Lessons whose prerequisites are done: in-progress first, then teaching order.

schema.title: Response Get Next Api V1 Progress Next Get

get.description: Progress of every lesson in teaching order (``not_started`` when never touched).

schema.title: Response List Lesson Progress Api V1 Progress Lessons Get

get.description: Progress of one lesson.

post.description: Start a study timer (one at a time; 409 if one is running).
Stop the running timer and add its time; ``discard`` drops it (409 if none runs).
Record study time manually: a session of ``minutes`` ending now.
Mark a lesson done (stops its running timer); lists the lessons it unlocked.

get.description: A lesson's quiz questions in order, without answers or explanations.

post.description:
Grade a whole attempt, store it, and return the feedback and any cards it created.

Recording is one transaction: the run, one attempt per question, flashcards for wrong
answers and for questions carrying a ``concept``, and the quiz activity marked done.

get.description: Cards due today (earliest due first), optionally limited to one lesson.

schema.title: Response Get Due Api V1 Review Due Get

post.description: Rate a card (again / hard / good / easy) and get its next review date.

get.description:
Weekly report (``rc report weekly``): time, completions, stuck points, next lessons.

Weeks run Monday to Sunday in the server's local timezone.
Per-module report (``rc report module``): lesson table, understanding distribution.

post.description: Create a local account (role learner) and mail an email-verification link.
Start a browser session. Five failures in 15 minutes lock the account temporarily.
End this browser session (needs the CSRF header).

Send the verification link again to the signed-in account's own address.

Needs a session, so there is nothing to enumerate and no address to type. 503 when the
server has no SMTP configuration — the client reads `email_verification` first and does
not offer this at all in that case. Already-verified accounts get 202 and no mail.
Confirm the email address with the mailed one-time token (valid 24 hours).

Mail a reset link (valid 30 minutes, single use) if the account exists.

The answer is the same whether or not the email is registered.
Set a new password with a reset token; every session of the account is ended.

get.description:
External logins configured through ``RC_OIDC_PROVIDERS``, for the sign-in buttons.

Unauthenticated on purpose — the login screen is reached without a session. Secrets are
never included. Empty in local mode, or when no provider is configured, which the
frontend reads as "show no provider buttons".

schema.title: Response Providers Api V1 Auth Providers Get

get.description:
Start an OIDC login (Authorization Code + PKCE). With an active browser session the
provider identity is linked to that account instead.

parameters.name: return_to

schema.description: App path to land on afterwards.
schema.title: Return To

parameters.description: App path to land on afterwards.

302.description: Redirect to the provider's login page

get.description:
Finish the OIDC login: check state, exchange the code with the PKCE verifier, verify
the id_token (signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce), then sign in or link.

302.description: Signed in; redirect into the app

get.description:
The signed-in user.

Reads the state rather than depending on ``Auth``, because local mode has no auth
service and this endpoint still answers there (with the stand-in user 1).

delete.description: Delete the account: learning data is removed now, the user row is anonymized.

patch.description: Change display name, locale or timezone.

put.description: Change the password; every other session of the account is ended.

get.description: Active browser sessions (devices) of the account.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Me Sessions Get

delete.description: End one of the account's sessions (e.g. a lost device).

get.description: Active personal access tokens (secrets are never shown again).

schema.title: Response List Tokens Api V1 Me Tokens Get

post.description: Issue a personal access token for programs (``Authorization: Bearer <token>``).

get.description:
The caller's progress and sessions: the JSON format of ``rc progress export``, so it
loads into local mode with ``rc progress import``.
External logins (OIDC providers) linked to the account.

schema.title: Response List Identities Api V1 Me Identities Get

delete.description: Unlink an external login (refused when it is the account's only way to sign in).

get.description: Users by id, cursor-paginated.

patch.description:
Change role or status. The last admin cannot be demoted or disabled, and admins
cannot remove their own admin access. Disabling ends the user's sessions and tokens.

delete.description: Force-logout: end every browser session of the user.

get.description: Audit log, newest first (reading it is itself audited).

ProgressExport.title: ProgressExport
ProgressExport.description:
JSON document produced by ``rc progress export`` (FR-10.2).

Lists added in schema version 2 default to empty, so a version-1 export still imports.

The validators enforce the invariants the database also enforces, so an edited or
hand-written file fails with a readable message instead of a sqlite error mid-import.
